label: Official test: presumption of an employment contract (Código do Trabalho, art. 12.º)
value: Employment is presumed when some of these are present: the work is done at a place belonging to or chosen by the client; the equipment and tools belong to the client; the worker keeps start and finish times set by the client; a fixed sum is paid at regular intervals for the work; the worker holds a management or supervisory role in the business

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, self-employed, non-resident and property
label: Corporate income tax (IRC) [national, with a municipal add-on]
value: 19% general rate in 2026 (18% in 2027, 17% from 2028); 15% on the first €50,000 for SMEs; derrama estadual 3%, 5%, 9% on profit over €1,500,000; derrama municipal up to 1.5%; 15% global minimum tax for groups with revenue of at least €750,000,000; Madeira 13.3%. Paid by companies and permanent establishments of non-resident companies. Código do IRC, articles 87.º and 87.º-A; Lei n.º 64/2025; Lei n.º 73/2013, article 18.º; Lei n.º 41/2024.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRS, Segurança Social and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Portal das Finanças (AT): Código do IRC, artigo 87.º Taxas (redação da Lei n.º 64/2025, de 7 de novembro, with its transitional rule, artigo 3.º)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, self-employed, non-resident and property
label: Branch profits and distributed profits [national]
value: no branch profits tax found (branches pay IRC like companies); dividends to non-resident companies 25% (exempt for qualifying EU, EEA and treaty parents), to individuals 28%, to low-tax jurisdictions 35%. Paid by the shareholder (withheld by the paying company). Código do IRC, articles 3.º, 14.º, 87.º and 94.º; Código do IRS, article 71.º.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRS, Segurança Social and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Portal das Finanças (AT): Código do IRC, artigos 3.º (base do imposto), 87.º-A (derrama estadual) and 94.º (retenção na fonte)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, self-employed, non-resident and property
label: Self-employed contributions (trabalhadores independentes) [national]
value: 21.4% on 70% of services or 20% of sales, declared quarterly; minimum €20 a month; base capped at 12 × IAS; contracting entities 7% or 10%. Paid by self-employed people; clients that take more than half of their activity. Código dos Regimes Contributivos (Lei n.º 110/2009), articles 140.º, 151.º to 168.º.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRS, Segurança Social and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Instituto da Segurança Social: Perguntas Frequentes – Novo regime dos trabalhadores independentes v09 (published 14 January 2026)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, self-employed, non-resident and property
label: Contractor rules: employment presumption and withholding on fees [national]
value: employment presumed under art. 12.º (and 12.º-A for platforms) of the Código do Trabalho; withholding of 23% on professional fees, 11.5% on other services, none below €15,000 a year on request. Paid by clients with organised accounts (withholding); employers (presumption). Código do Trabalho, articles 12.º and 12.º-A; Código do IRS, articles 101.º, 101.º-B and 115.º.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRS, Segurança Social and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Diário da República, 1.ª série, n.º 30, 12 de fevereiro de 2009: Lei n.º 7/2009 (Código do Trabalho), artigo 12.º Presunção de contrato de trabalho (n.º 1 unchanged by Lei n.º 13/2023)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, self-employed, non-resident and property
label: Simplified regimes (IRS and IRC regime simplificado; small-business exemption) [national]
value: IRS: gross income up to €200,000, taxable share 15% to 95% by activity; IRC: income up to €200,000; VAT exemption up to €15,000 of turnover. Paid by self-employed people and small companies that use them. Código do IRS, articles 28.º and 31.º; Código do IRC, articles 86.º-A and 86.º-B; Código do IVA, article 53.º.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRS, Segurança Social and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Portal das Finanças (AT): Código do IRS, artigo 31.º Regime simplificado; artigo 28.º Formas de determinação dos rendimentos empresariais e profissionais

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, self-employed, non-resident and property
label: Non-resident tax on employment income [national]
value: 25% final withholding on gross pay, nothing on pay up to the minimum wage from a single payer; EU and EEA residents can claim a refund down to the general scale; resident after more than 183 days or with a usual home. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). Código do IRS, articles 16.º and 71.º.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRS, Segurança Social and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Portal das Finanças (AT): Código do IRS, artigo 71.º Taxas liberatórias (n.os 4 to 13)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, self-employed, non-resident and property
label: Property tax: IMI and AIMI (imposto municipal sobre imóveis) [municipal (AIMI national)]
value: IMI: urban property 0.3% to 0.45% set by each municipality, rustic 0.8%; AIMI: 0.7% to 1.5% for individuals above €600,000, 0.4% for companies. Paid by owners of property on 1 January. Código do IMI, articles 112.º and 135.º-A to 135.º-I.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; IRS, Segurança Social and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
